\- Eye Tracking Data Collection  
	\- sebelumnya, kita ada Deteksi Grid → nanti, digunakan di phase 2 yaitu adaptasi GUI berdasarkan cognitive, kita masih di phase 1 yaitu, deteksi cognitive load menggunakan multimodal fusi sensor  
	\- fokus mengumpulan data / fitur sebanyak2nya  
	\- Gaze\_X dan Gaze\_Y sdh ada, EAR left dan right sdh ada

\- setiap frame, kita kumpulkan data2 berikut:

| Column Name  | Data Type | Calculation Method |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Timestamp  | Float  | Record the exact system time using Python's `time.time()` the moment OpenCV reads the frame.  |
| EAR\_Left  | Float  | Extract the specific eyelid landmarks from the MediaPipe Face Mesh. Calculate the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelid points, divided by the horizontal distance between the eye corners to get the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR).  |
| EAR\_Right | Float  | Same mathematical calculation as EAR\_Left, applied to the right eye's facial landmarks.  |
| Is\_Blink  | Boolean | Apply a conditional statement to the EAR columns. If the EAR drops below a specific calibrated threshold (typically around 0.2 to 0.25), log this value as True.  |
| Iris\_Radius  | Float  | Use the MediaPipe Iris tracking framework to extract the (x, y) coordinates for the center of the iris and its outer edge points. Calculate the Euclidean distance between the center and the edges to track relative pupil/iris size dynamically.  |
| Gaze\_X  | Integer | Use MediaPipe to detect head orientation landmarks (like the nose tip and chin) combined with the eye vectors. Run these coordinates through an OpenCV calibration matrix (which you must set up at the start of your script) to map the 3D gaze vector to a 2D screen pixel on the X-axis.  |
| Gaze\_Y | Integer | Use the same calibration matrix to map the estimated gaze to the Y-axis of your screen.  |
| Eye\_State  | String | Apply a dispersion threshold algorithm to the `Gaze_X` and `Gaze_Y` columns. If the gaze coordinates remain clustered within a small pixel radius over several consecutive frames, label this row as "Fixation". If a rapid jump in distance between consecutive frames is detected, label it as "Saccade".  |

PENGUMPULAN DATA (PER PESERTA)

\+ jalanin server dgn nama peserta dan puzzle set latihan
